mainText: Hello, Verona! At 6 AM, here is today's balanced dish: we have clear skies at Badger Prairie County Park, 56 degrees, and an air quality index of 52. The full moon is currently overhead.

Construction alert for Hwy M, where flaggers will manage traffic on Monday and Tuesday for utility work. Also, September is Suicide Prevention Month in Verona, bringing awareness to this critical public health issue.

There is a lot happening, including live music today at Bailey's Run Vineyard and Wisconsin Brewing Company. Tomorrow, check out the Farmers Market at the Capitol or music at Paddy Mac's, followed by the Kids Triathlon on August 30.
On August 19, there was a motor vehicle crash with injuries on North Main Street, where two drivers were cited for various traffic violations.
The Culver's flavor of the day is OREO Cookie Overload, and the store opens today at 10:00 AM for you to enjoy your treat.
